notes: INSIDE half of the Fenn Twitch Cannon: a small escapement gear that ticks half a step on every charge frame, a spring, and a row of ten tiny lamps that fill two per step (frame 5 = all green); power coupling, small hatch. fire: the lamps flash white and the spring is slack. damaged: the gear cracked and out of true, lamps dead, sparks; disabled: the gear off its axle, the spring sprung. Barrel layer fenn_twitch_cannon_barrel: a slim steel barrel with a coiled recoil spring and a slotted muzzle brake; it twitches (fire recoil 2/1/0). COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
